rationale: The app demands an immersive, cinematic feel. Using deep Obsidian and Velvet blacks with high-contrast Golden Ticket Amber and rich imagery creates a luxury theater experience directly on mobile. Textures and lighting take precedence over flat UI.

rules: Use Cabinet Grotesk for bold, punchy display headings (H1, H2) with tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Use Satoshi for highly legible, modern body copy.
Maximum heading size: text-4xl on mobile, text-6xl on desktop.
Hierarchy gap: Jump between headings and subheadings should not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
No generic defaults like Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.
setup_instructions: Install via @fontsource/cabinet-grotesk and @fontsource/satoshi, or import from Fontshare.
Extend Tailwind config to include font-heading: 'Cabinet Grotesk, sans-serif' and font-sans: 'Satoshi, sans-serif'.

rules: Tinted Greys ONLY: Never use pure #000000. Base is Obsidian (#060608).
Text visibility: Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA standards. Use text shadows when layering over images.
Primary Brand (Amber) is strictly for interactive CTAs, swipe highlights, and key 'Savings' metrics.
Mobile-first grids. Use generous padding (p-6, p-8) inside containers.
Movie detail cards must not exceed 80vh to prevent blocking UI.
Cardless or subtly rounded corners (max rounded-2xl).
Optical alignment: Padding left/right should account for icons.
patterns: Swipe Discovery Stack: Absolute positioning with fluid Framer Motion transforms. The top card should be fully opaque, subsequent cards stacked beneath with decreasing scale and opacity.
Bottom Tab Navigation: Fixed at bottom, glassmorphic (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-black/60 border-t border-white/10).
Subscription Dashboard: High density 'Control Room' grid layout for savings data.

components_strategy.buttons: Flat, sharp or slightly rounded corners. Golden Amber bg with black text for Primary. Glassmorphic outlines for Secondary.
components_strategy.cards: Movie discovery cards should be full-bleed image based with an aggressive gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/40 to-transparent) to ensure text legibility.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn based. Dark surfaces, amber focus rings (focus:ring-amber-500).
components_strategy.modals: Shadcn Dialog. Use Crystal Glass backdrop (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60).
components_strategy.motion: Use Framer Motion for swipe cards (drag='x', dragConstraints, exit animations for Save/Skip). Page transitions should fade and slide up.

rules: Use Lucide icons with 1.5px stroke width for a lighter, premium feel.
Animate icons on hover where applicable.

hero_posters.description: Sci-fi epic cinematic poster. Use for high-impact discovery card.
Neo-noir thriller cinematic poster. Use for discovery card.
Fantasy epic cinematic poster. Use for discovery card.

backgrounds.description: Golden light flares on dark background. Use for onboarding/login screens behind glass overlays.

avatars.description: User profile avatar for settings/profile page.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme colors provided.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000). Use the provided Obsidian black.
For the swipe interface, use Framer Motion for drag and drop interactions.
Implement bottom tab navigation for mobile layout.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use Shadcn UI for standard components but heavily customize them to remove borders and apply the dark cinematic aesthetic.
Movie posters must have a gradient overlay to ensure text contrast at the bottom of the card.
